# Traverse

> Traverse is a cognitive science-powered learning platform combining mind maps, spaced repetition, and flashcards to help students and professionals master complex subjects faster.

Traverse specializes in evidence-based learning techniques including active recall and spaced repetition, with particular strength in language learning (Mandarin Chinese) and technical subjects like MCAT preparation and machine learning research. The platform serves a global community of learners through integrated note-taking, mind mapping, and flashcard tools.

## Key Topics

- Spaced Repetition
- Mind Mapping
- Flashcards
- Active Recall
- Cognitive Science

## Mandarin Chinese Learning

- [Unlock the Secrets to Understanding Mandarin Grammar Easily | Traverse](https://traverse.link/mandarin-learning/understanding-mandarin-grammar): Mandarin grammar guide by Dominic Zijlstra for language learners
- [Mastering Mandarin: An Essential Guide to Chinese Learn Tones | Traverse](https://traverse.link/mandarin-learning/chinese-learn-tones): Guide to Mandarin Chinese tones and pronunciation for language learners
- [Unlock the Puzzle: Overcoming Common Challenges in Learning Chinese | Traverse](https://traverse.link/mandarin-learning/common-challenges-in-learning-chinese): Guide to overcoming Mandarin learning challenges: characters, tones, pronunciation
- [Master the Art of Mandarin Conversations with these Proven Techniques | Traverse](https://traverse.link/mandarin-learning/learn-spoken-mandarin): Techniques for spoken Mandarin conversation using Pinyin and spaced repetition
